name: Go Around aerodrome runways + elevation database
lock_note: LOCKED. Never edit this file in place. v2 = v1 after the full verification (tools/rwdb/verify_v2.py); a new version is a new file (v3).

sources.osm: Geofabrik africa/south-africa-261114.osm.pbf (OpenStreetMap data as of 2026-11-14), downloaded 2026-11-15T11:51Z, ODbL
sources.aip: SACAA AIP 15 JUL 2026 compilation, extracted 2026-10-21 (site/rwy/rwy-data.js), AD 2.2 elevations from site/wst/wst-data.js
sources.aip_elevation_v2: SACAA AIP AD 2 PDFs in site/aip/<icao>/ad2-<icao>.pdf, AD 2.2 item 3, read 2026-11-15
sources.terrain_v2: Open-Meteo elevation API (Copernicus DEM GLO-90), metres, 2026-11-15T12:30Z

rules: No value is guessed. Runway headings come only from a published true bearing (SACAA AIP, OurAirports) or from measured geometry (OurAirports threshold coordinates, OpenStreetMap ways). Designators are used only to label which end is which, never as a heading.
Magnetic headings are derived as true minus WMM2025 declination unless the AIP publishes one.
Elevation priority: SACAA AIP > OurAirports > terrain model (tagged terrain_derived).
Every value carries src, url and retrieved.

v2: every record carries verification{heading[], elevation, position}. Heading resolution AIP > OSM measured > OurAirports; elevation AIP (AD 2 PDF) > terrain at the measured runway > OurAirports (when consistent with the ground) > terrain at the card.
v2: AIP records whose ARP is more than 5 km from the card are not used for that card (FAKG).
Sources stay in this file for the admin dashboard only; the public cards never show source names or dates.
